items.t: Stord Acquires AMS Fulfillment in Nine-Figure Deal
items.d:
E-Commerce logistics provider Stord made its largest acquisition to date acquiring competitor AMS Fulfillment. The deal includes 10 warehouses, which will bring Stord's global network to over 100 locations. 
Sean Henry, CEO and founder of Stord discusses the deal as well as the overall outlook for the shipping and logistics space. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.fullText: NVIDIA Open Models Advance Europe’s Sovereign Intelligence Across Industries New model families for vision and language, retrieval, tabular data, biology, robotics and quantum computing supercharge development in Europe. October 21, 2026 by Kari Briski 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! NVIDIA is expanding its family of open models across language, robotics, biology, and quantum computing, giving developers, researchers and enterprises what they need to build applications tailored to local languages and industries The portfolio includes the new NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Super VL and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt models; new NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever models for embedding, reranking and document parsing; the new NVIDIA Kumo family open weight foundation models and libraries for structured business data; NVIDIA Cosmos 3.5 world models; NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Edge for autonomous vehicles; NVIDIA BioNeMo for healthcare and scientific discovery; and NVIDIA Ising for quantum computing. The open models give organizations a foundation they can customize with local data and deploy on infrastructure they control. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements NVIDIA Nemotron Powers Post-Training Across Industries NVIDIA Nemotron brings open language models, datasets and recipes to developers building agents. The models support text and images, helping agents orchestrate workflows, reason through complex problems and complete specialized tasks at a lower cost. Nemotron models are built with data, research and expertise from the NVIDIA Nemotron Coalition , including European partners Black Forest Labs , H-Company and Mistral . Nemotron provides a foundation for enterprises to build applications based on their own knowledge and expertise. items.fullText: GTC Berlin 2026: Live Updates From NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang’s Keynote October 21, 2026 by Brian Caulfield 0 Comments Share Share This Article X Facebook LinkedIn Copy link Link copied! Founded in a tent near the Berlin Wall in 1980, the Tempodrom moved several times before settling near Anhalter Bahnhof in 2001. Its permanent home has since hosted concerts, galas and political events. Today, it hosts a different kind of spectacle. GTC Berlin runs three days, with more than 100 sessions on agentic AI, robotics, physical AI, open models and accelerated computing underway at STATION-Berlin down the road. Here, journalists, analysts and partners have gathered for the main event: NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang’s keynote. Huang Takes the Stage Huang opened with a question: What do L’Oréal, Revolut, Spotify, Merck, Vodafone, Zara, Porsche, Nestlé and HSBC have in common? They’re all European companies and they’re all working with NVIDIA on AI, he said. The keynote comes on the heels of NVIDIA’s weeklong road across Europe — Paris, London, Stockholm, Dublin — with the company committing nearly $10 billion to the technology ecosystem across Europe and working with 12,000+ partners. “After decades of advancement in the computer industry, we are now at the beginnings of a new industrial revolution,” Huang said. Read All NVIDIA in Europe Announcements AI is a five-layer cake , Huang explained. Energy powers advanced computers that are part of an AI factory, which generates tokens and digital intelligence from the models that run on it, which are then integrated into every application. “Long before the AI models emerge, the infrastructure has to exist,” he said, highlighting how, similarly, the internet first needed networking, and electricity first required the grid. “To be part of this AI economy, you don’t want to just be consuming the AI; you want to be producing the AI,” Huang said. “We could do all of that here in Europe, and in fact, we’ve already started.” The AI Fac

HD현대로보틱스 '지능형 양팔로봇' 공개
items.fullText: 산업 한경 PREMIUM9 AI를 넘어서는 성공투자 구독하기 AI 추천 뉴스 AI 추천 뉴스 팝업 닫기 HD현대로보틱스 '지능형 양팔로봇' 공개 입력 2026.10.21 17:31 수정 2026.10.21 17:31 지면 A16 기사 스크랩 기사 스크랩 댓글 댓글 기사 공유 공유 글자크기 조절 글자크기 프린트 프린트 강해령 기자 구독하기 구글 검색 선호 출처로 추가 Google 검색에서 한국경제 기사를 더 자주 볼 수 있습니다. 피지컬 AI 시장 공략 속도 HD현대로보틱스가 제조 현장에서 활용할 수 있는 ‘지능형 양팔로봇’(사진)을 공개했다. 향후 두 발로 걷는 로봇 기술까지 확보해 피지컬 인공지능(AI) 시장에 본격적으로 진입한다는 계획이다. HD현대로보틱스는 21일 대구 엑스코에서 개막한 ‘미래혁신기술박람회 2026’에서 사람의 상체와 유사한 구조의 로봇을 공개했다. 이 로봇의 양팔은 각각 7kg의 가반하중(들어올릴 수 있는 최대 무게)과 630㎜의 작업 반경을 갖췄다. 다섯 손가락 구조를 적용해 사람이 물체를 쥐고 옮기는 것과 같은 정교한 작업을 수행할 수 있다. 자체 개발한 로봇 파운데이션 모델도 탑재됐다. HD현대로보틱스 관계자는 “지난달 지분 투자한 에이딘로보틱스와의 협업으로 양팔과 손의 작업 성능을 개선할 계획”이라고 설명했다. HD현대로보틱스는 지능형 양팔로봇을 제조 현장에 공급할 예정이다. 우선 각종 묶음·조립 공정에 적용한 후, 용접·도장 등으로 적용 범위를 넓힐 계획이다. 로봇의 이동 능력도 단계적으로 향상한다. 지능형 양팔로봇에 휠(바퀴) 플랫폼을 결합한 후, 2족 보행 기술까지 적용할 방침이다. HD현대로보틱스 관계자는 “산업용 로봇 시장에서 축적한 설계·제어·양산 노하우로 피지컬 AI 기술을 선점할 것”이라고 했다. 강해령 기자 hr.kang@hankyung.com 좋아요 싫어요 후속기사 원해요 ⓒ 한경닷컴, 무단전재 및 재배포 금지 한국경제 구독신청 한경 프리미엄9 구독신청 강해령 기자 시장에 도움이 되는 정보를 전달하기 위해 최선을 다하겠습니다. Ex-Nvidia-turned-VC Amulya Vishwanath: ‘Physical AI is in its LEGO era’
items.d: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity.
items.fullText: It’s the moment everyone is waiting for — the ChatGPT moment for robotics, Amulya Vishwanath explained to TechCrunch’s Equity. She is the founder and managing partner of Techable Ventures, a VC firm focused on physical AI, which she started after spending nearly seven years as a product marketer at Nvidia. Before that, she held the same role at a company that was later bought by Intel and was a digital signal processing engineer at Interconnect Systems, which was later bought by the electronics manufacturer Molex. Listen on Apple Podcasts Listen on Spotify She stopped by Equity to talk about the future of physical AI — one of the industry’s latest buzzwords. “A lot of companies and experts have been talking about the ChatGPT moment for robotics,” she said, adding that right now the industry was more in a “LEGO era.” “There are a lot of foundational software and building blocks for robotics that are being rethought right now as we speak, and it’s super important in order for innovation to scale,” she continued. Right now, people are building the basics — the robotic hands or the actuators — that can one day come together and build that big-ticket-item, like a bunch of LEGOs coming together. There’s general- and special-purpose robots being built right now, too, and eventually, as people continue building them, they will get better and more advanced. “We’ve done this during the internet era,” she said. “We’ve done this long, long time ago with the Industrial Revolution. I think it’s just a matter of time before things fall into place.” “Talent is also going to be very critical,” she continued, adding elsewhere in the convo that talent is still a key definer of the U.S. market. This is one of the “moats” of her firm, she said, helping connect founders to top talent so they can stay competitive right now, as so much talent is going to big companies like Anthropic and Nvidia.
